scripts.build: npm run format && npm run assets && npm run pio
scripts.test: npm run build && npm run pio:monitor
scripts.format: npm run format:cpp && npm run format:web
scripts.format:web: prettier --write 'src/**/*.{js,json,css,html}' platformio.ini package.json README.md vite.config.mjs tailwind.config.js
scripts.format:cpp: command -v clang-format >/dev/null 2>&1 && find src -iname '*.h' -o -iname '*.cpp' -o -iname '*.ino' | xargs clang-format -i || echo 'clang-format not found, skipping format:cpp'
scripts.pio: npm run pio:firmware && sleep 2 && npm run pio:filesystem
scripts.pio:ota: npm run pio:ota:firmware && sleep 2 && npm run pio:ota:filesystem
scripts.wokwi:compile-chip: docker run --rm -v "$(pwd):/src" -w /src ghcr.io/webassembly/wasi-sdk:wasi-sdk-22 clang-17 --target=wasm32-wasi --sysroot=/wasi-sysroot -nostartfiles -Wl,--import-memory -Wl,--export-table -Wl,--no-entry -Werror -o wokwi/pcf8575.chip.wasm wokwi/pcf8575.chip.c -Iwokwi
